narration:0:1460445001:0.text: At Xera's insistence, you head back to the clinic and start working on the new recipe.
narration:0:1460445001:0.source_cn: 在席蕾的催促下，你回到了医馆，开始试图研发新的药方。

narration:1:1460445002:0.text: Despite the time and effort, your attempts yield no results...
narration:1:1460445002:0.source_cn: 但根据现有的情报和材料，你研究了一段时间，却始终无法找...

narration:2:1460445003:0.text: Just as your progress stalls, an unexpected visitor arrives with a patient in tow.
narration:2:1460445003:0.source_cn: 正当此时，另一位不速之客带着一位患者，前来拜访了。
